description:
Amentum is seeking a Software Engineer to support Naval projects in Dahlgren, VA. This position will support the development, integration, testing, and deployment of software for DoW weapons and sensor systems. The Software Engineer will work as part of a cross-functional systems and software engineering team supporting mission-critical applications and modernization efforts.

 Software Engineer Responsibilities Include: 

 Develop, integrate, test, and deploy software in C/C++, Java, and/or Python .
 Support software requirements development, architecture, design, and testing.
 Support modern weapon system software development, testing, and deployment activities.
 Utilize development and collaboration tools including Git, Jira, and static code analysis tools .
 Apply modern software development practices, including Agile, Scrum, and DevSecOps .
 Collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams consisting of industry and government personnel.
 Communicate technical information effectively with engineering personnel, customers, senior managers, and program managers.
 Work independently and collaboratively to meet established program goals and schedules.
 Support continuous improvement and professional development by expanding technical knowledge and capabilities.
 
 Minimum Requirements: 

 0–10 years of relevant software development or engineering experience. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another applicable technical field , or equivalent experience in lieu of the education requirement.
 Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies .
 Effective written and verbal communication skills.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in support of scientific and engineering work.
 Ability to work independently and within established teams to meet schedule-driven requirements.
 Must have an active Secret security clearance. Note: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a Secret clearance. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Experience with embedded systems, GNC algorithms, and High/Low/Medium Fidelity Simulators .
 One (1) or more years of experience with Surface Combat Systems or DoW weapons system sustainment .
 Experience sustaining software systems on surface ships and/or subsurface boats .
 Systems engineering experience supporting the development and integration of software systems on surface ships and/or subsurface platforms .
        
 Compensation Details: 
$110,000        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
10/02/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
